name: xdBot Audiotrack
description: Adds an Audiotrack section to the xdBot menu: align a .wav (clicks) to the macro's first input and play it with the macro.

mic-device.name: Microphone
mic-device.description: Part of the real microphone's name to pass through the Audiotrack Mic cable. Empty = the default microphone.

cable-device.name: Cable playback device
cable-device.description: Part of the name of the virtual cable's playback device the mixer writes to. VB-Cable: CABLE Input.

mic-click-offset.name: Click delay in the microphone (ms)
mic-click-offset.description: Delays the Audiotrack clicks that go into the microphone cable by this many milliseconds, so they line up with your own clicks that reach the cable late through a slow microphone (WO Mic over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth). Negative plays them earlier. It does not affect the in-game sound. Set it once.

start-mixer.name: Start the mixer with the game
start-mixer.description: Starts the mixer when the game launches (if a virtual cable is installed), so the cable carries your voice as long as GD is open.
